pr_comments: Given that we don't officially support async mocking, I think this deserves discussion before being approved. I don't think it needs a gRFC as it seems to be adding an API only to support the actual implementation of a class whose API was set before the gRFC process actually started.
@vjpai This PR is now ready to get review.

> Can you also run this through an internal global presubmit? Assuming that there are some internal users that have already done these overrides in their derived classes.

That's a good idea. Will do!
Internal cl/354329482 is made to run the global presubmit -> passed
@vjpai anything else needed here, besides a rebase?  Not critical on my end, but would be nice to get closed out.

review_comments: Are these meaningful checks? Can absl::make_unique ever return nullptr? Is there some other  check that would make this more useful of a test?
Yeah, this is basically to make sure that they're not abstract classes. (meaning all methods are mocked) I guess this should be enough.
Would a more useful test be then to actually derive mocks from these and then use them the way that a user actually would? I'm not fond of the idea of having a test that's basically just a build.

I don't think it gives more test coverage, though because it's testing the mock feature of gtest. If the class is ready to be mockable, I think it's enough for this test? This test is designed to make sure those classes are mockable. (Previously those were not)
